current_grouping: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UAV Design and Construction
versions.text: If a UAV system contains ground equipment affecting flight safety not defined in this code, such equipment shall be designed using the applicable standards and shown not to adversely affect any requirement of this code.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D – UA Design and Construction
versions.text: If a UAS contains ground equipment affecting flight safety not defined in this code, such equipment shall be designed using the applicable standards and shown not to adversely affect any requirement of this code.
